Market today: The tech and chip sectors are riding high today, fueled by strong earnings from cloud and AI leaders like Amazon and Microsoft. This positive momentum directly impacts your concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.92%) and SPAL (-57.93%) are deep in the red and leveraged; their default stops need immediate review. QQQ (-4.35%), SMH (-15.32%), and QQQI (-6.61%) are also flagged "SELL" and are close to their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the stops for your underperforming leveraged ETFs. Also, monitor for continued strength in the broader chip sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions while the tech rally continues.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL stops. These leveraged ETFs are deep in the red; consider tightening stops or reducing exposure given margin.
Monitor QQQ, SMH, and QQQI closely as they are near their stops. Be ready to act if breached.
MSFT looks strong with earnings and a scanner setup. Consider an entry around 450.65-450.2 with a stop at 449.52.
